cards.card_text: He keeps going: can Job bring forth the constellations in their seasons, or lead out the Bear and her cubs?
cards.verse_text: Can you bring forth the constellations in their seasons or lead out the Bear and her cubs?
cards.snippet: Can you bring forth the constellations in their seasons or lead out the Bear and her cubs?

cards.card_text: The stars of heaven and their constellations won't give their light, and the rising sun will be darkened.
cards.verse_text: For the stars of heaven and their constellations will not give their light.
cards.snippet: For the stars of heaven and their constellations will not give their light.
